cards.name: Vals Index v2.2 / October 30
cards.question: How do models score on Vals Index v2.2?
cards.tests: This composite combines finance, coding, legal and tax benchmark results with GDP-based sector weights.
cards.matters: The index summarizes these benchmark tasks; it does not measure economic automation.
cards.read: The October 30 table reports 32 model names. Effort and agent settings are unspecified in this table. Earlier snapshots and versions remain distinct. Cost per test includes token-estimated Code Migration costs, and reported durations have an unverified composite aggregation; both are retained in source details. Evaluation dates and model snapshots are unknown.

variants.label: v2.2 / October 30 / 32 reported models
variants.coverage: All 32 rows displayed in the source table; source settings may vary by model.

settings.methodology: Four sector scores weighted 8.0 finance, 5.6 coding, 1.2 legal, 0.5 tax divided by 15.3; GDP-based weights do not measure actual economic automation. Tax was added in v2.1, not v2.2. v2.2 changes component versions and tax all-pass grading. Code Migration uses 50 of 120 CLI tasks plus 10 COBOL tasks, weighted 75/25. Index costs include token-estimated Code Migration costs. Table does not specify exact effort or harness per model.

limitations: GDP weights do not measure real-world economic automation.
Exact per-model effort, agents, evaluation dates, task-level costs and generic latencies are unknown.
Code Migration cost is token-estimated.

cards.name: LADDER / robot manipulation
cards.question: How reliably do robot systems complete multi-step manipulation tasks?
cards.tests: LADDER tests robot systems in simulation across 145 tasks and 2,024 episodes per system. Separate selectors show a 10-task Lite subset and individual real-robot tasks.
cards.matters: Long tasks require a robot and its controller to complete every step; results are specific to the tested systems and settings.
cards.read: Full simulation scores pool episodes across suites; an equal-suite mean is a separate metric. Lite uses 10 tasks and must not be compared as a full-suite score. Hardware tasks use 12 episodes per system and are separate from simulation; the physical verifier differs. API costs per successful episode are source-reported estimates excluding simulator and low-level GPU costs, not cost per attempt. Evaluation dates and model effort remain unknown.

variants.label: Full simulation / 145 tasks / pooled episodes

settings.methodology: Three simulation suites; full pooled episode success and equally weighted suite mean are different metrics. Lite is 10 tasks and is not pooled into full results. Real Franka and WidowX tasks are separate cohorts; hardware proprioceptive verifier uses Gemini Robotics-ER 2, not the simulation verifier. API costs per successful episode use September 25 provider list prices, exclude simulator and low-level GPU costs; caching uncertainty makes GPT-Policy costs upper bounds, and missing Argon output tokens are estimated. Full-suite published plus/minus values are rounded 95% Wilson intervals in percentage points; exact endpoints are not reconstructed.

limitations: Three simulation suites; full pooled episode success and equally weighted suite mean are different metrics. Lite is 10 tasks and is not pooled into full results.
